messages:
devon: Quick postmortem follow-up — summary of action items from today's streaming incident (timeouts -> partial responses -> reconnect edgecases). TL;DR: we need explicit owners, short timelines, and a weekly pulse check.

maria: I'll own the telemetry gaps for timeouts. Will add missing traces for handshake + KV cache events by EOD.

sam: I'll take reconnect logic review. Plan: prototype a jittered backoff, add max-concurrent-reconnect cap, and run it through the chaos harness. ETA next Tue.

jen: I'll coordinate canary tests for the reconnect changes and add perf gates to the Console. Need sam's PR before Thursday to schedule canary.

alex_r: I'll push a small client heartbeat TTL increase to reduce false-positive disconnects (safe change). Can land today if no objections — @devon?

devon: @alex_r go for it. @maria please create the follow-up tickets and link them here.

oncall-bot: Ticket created: INF-4321 streaming-timeouts-telemetry (https://redwood.internal/t/INF-4321) — assigned to maria.

maria: Added checklist and initial notes in INF-4321. Also created INF-4322 (reconnect-review) assigned to sam and INF-4323 (heartbeat-ttl) assigned to alex_r. Links in the ticket.

sam: Putting my design notes into INF-4322 now. Early plan includes:
```
- jittered backoff: base 200ms, max 5s, factor 1.6
- cap concurrent reconnects per-client: 3
- add server-side reconnect window validation
```
Starting perf tests against the 500-user replay after lunch.

jen: Can we add a recurring weekly check for streaming timeouts >95p? I'll add a dashboard and a PagerDuty rule; proposed owner = eng-runtime rotation.

devon: Agreed. Jen, please add the dashboard link and set the rotation. Also add regression tests in the eval harness to catch partial-response regressions when reconnect behavior changes.

maria: Done: dashboard saved (https://redwood.internal/d/stream-timeouts) and PD rule created. Weekly check scheduled Mondays 10:00 PST. @jen confirm rotation start date?

jen: Rotation starts next Monday. Added oncall playbook steps to INF-4321 (check traces, run quick replay, escalate if >3% partials).

devon: Action recap: 
- INF-4321 telemetry gaps (maria) — EOD
- INF-4322 reconnect review + prototype (sam) — next Tue
- INF-4323 heartbeat TTL patch (alex_r) — today
- Canary + perf gates (jen) — before Thu
- Weekly timeout pulse (jen) — start next Monday
We'll reconvene Fri 11:00 to validate progress and unblock any rollouts.

maria: Noted, I'll post progress updates in this thread and mark subtasks in INF-4321.

alex_r: Patch landed, rolling to staging now. Command used: `/deploy staging heartbeat-ttl-bump-2026-03-23`

oncall-bot: Deploy started: staging/heartbeat-ttl-bump-2026-03-23 by alex_r — build #8852.

sam: Test harness results trickling in — reconnects stable in ~98% of replays, found 2 IPv6-specific retransmit cases. I'm adding notes to INF-4322 and a short script to reproduce.

devon: Great work. If anything blocks the Friday sync ping here or @devex. Also please add brief one-line status updates to the tickets daily. Thanks all :thumbsup:
